tools.name: us_municipal_building_permits
tools.description: Query official US municipal building, solar, roofing, and electrical permits (Chicago, LA, NYC, Austin, San Francisco, Seattle) via Socrata OpenData APIs.

cities.description: City codes (chicago, nyc, la, austin, sf, seattle)

keyword.description: Optional work description keyword (e.g., SOLAR, ROOF, ELECTRICAL)

tools.name: fmcsa_usdot_trucking_carriers
tools.description: Query official US Department of Transportation (FMCSA) commercial trucking carrier registrations, fleet sizes, and USDOT numbers.

state.description: 2-letter US state code (e.g., TX, CA, FL, IL)

tools.name: state_ucc_financing_filings
tools.description: Query official State Secretary of State Uniform Commercial Code (UCC-1) financing statements, debtors, and secured lenders.

states.description: States to query (e.g., NY, CO, OR)

tools.name: greenhouse_lever_ashby_ats_jobs
tools.description: Query live engineering, AI, and executive job openings directly from Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby public ATS APIs.

greenhouseBoards.description: Greenhouse board slugs (e.g., stripe, anthropic, cloudflare)

tools.name: sec_edgar_corporate_filings

tickers.description: US stock tickers (e.g., NVDA, AAPL, MSFT)
